pool_easy: A stone well with a RED bucket hanging from its rope.

A white goat tied by a rope to a wooden post.
A blue umbrella lying UPSIDE DOWN on the ground, filled with water like a bowl.
A ladder leaning against a house wall with a black cat sitting on its TOP rung.
Two glass bottles side by side — the LEFT one completely full of green liquid, the RIGHT one completely empty.
A woman cutting a long yellow rope in half with big scissors.
A wooden barrel with a lit fuse sparking on top.
A wheelbarrow carrying a folded checkered blanket.
A round wooden shield leaning on a fence, with a yellow star painted in its center.
A boy aiming a slingshot at a brass bell hanging from a beam.

A brown dog asleep INSIDE a woven basket.
A golden key stuck halfway into the trunk of a small tree.
A fisherman holding up a net with exactly TWO fish caught in it.
A red-and-white diamond-shaped kite tangled in the branches of the same small tree.
pool_hard: A fisherman holding up a net with exactly FIVE fish in it, while a seagull sits on his LEFT shoulder.
A stone wall with exactly THREE round holes; water spurts out of the MIDDLE hole only.
One tall pole carrying two lanterns: a RED lantern in front almost completely hides a WHITE lantern hanging directly behind it — only a thin white crescent edge shows.
Two identical small wooden boards side by side: the LEFT board has exactly FIVE black dots, the RIGHT board has exactly THREE black dots.
A brass padlock with exactly FOUR keyholes arranged like the four pips of a die, hanging on a teal box.
A man seen from behind pours water from a metal bucket into a low arched opening at the bottom of a brick wall.
A white goat behind iron window bars, with a brown burlap sack full of white salt standing beside it, also behind the bars.
A seedling in a pot whose stem is cut open lengthwise: the LEFT half of the stem shows many tiny square cells, the RIGHT half shows a few long cells packed with yellow corn kernels.
A tool lying on a shelf, made of three parts in a row: a round wooden knob handle, a coiled metal spring in the middle, and a flat metal blade at the end.
A boy holding up a glass jar that is completely empty except for exactly TWO tiny grains at the very bottom.
Exactly FOUR flower pots in a row: the FIRST and THIRD have red flowers, the SECOND and FOURTH show only bare soil.
A ladder with exactly FIVE rungs leaning against a tree, with a black cat sitting on the SECOND rung from the bottom.
A round clock on a tower wall whose face has no marks at all and only ONE hand, pointing straight DOWN. (상태 · 방향)
A woman holding a tray with exactly THREE cups in a row; only the MIDDLE cup is upside down. (개수 3 · 가운데만 · 상태)
A brown dog asleep INSIDE a wooden barrel that lies on its side. (안 · 상태)
A birdcage hanging from a hook with its door wide OPEN and nothing inside; a yellow bird sits on TOP of the cage. (빔 · 위)
